column3: 34. (1) The Commission may make rules in respect of –
the  appointment,  employment  and  dismissal  of
various  officers  and  their  powers,  duties  and
the  procedure  to  be  observed  at  the  summoning
and  holding  of  meetings,  annual  general  meeting
and extraordinary meetings of the Commission;
the administration and management of the affairs
all matters in respect of which, rules are required or
authorized to be made under this Act.
